subject: Civic Education
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the importance of working to protect self as well as others at disasters.
Emphasises the need for acting according to the situations in disasters.
the_entrance: The importance of working intelligently and according to the situation at disasters.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of working intelligently in disaster situations and explain the importance of protecting oneself and others.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will take notes on the importance of working intelligently and according to the situation at disasters.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Formative assessment check on student understanding

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on the importance of acting according to the situation in disasters.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will engage in group discussions and present their findings.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
